description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a fast-growing self-serve hot pot chain founded in 2021, offering over 100 fresh ingredients and more than 10 broth and dry-mix options so diners build their own meal at the table. The UBC location is one of roughly 18 locations across Greater Vancouver, Ontario, and the US. Touring cyclists can expect a filling, customizable hot meal with vegetarian and vegan options.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (20 spaces) at 11m; stands (5 spaces) at 52m; safe_loops (42 spaces) at 58m; stands (3 spaces) at 94m. Total: 70 spaces.
